challenges.title: Acoustic AI Leakage Detection & Non-Revenue Water Reduction in Urban Distribution Networks

challenges.problemStatement: Urban water distribution pipelines lose up to 38% of drinking water due to undetected underground leakages and pressure anomalies before water reaches end-user households.
challenges.targetOutcome: Non-invasive acoustic IoT sensor deployment on primary distribution mains, detecting leaks within 5 meters precision within 2 hours of pipe micro-fracture.

challenges.expectedImpact: Save over 4.5 million liters of potable water daily, reduce energy cost by 18%, and lower municipal repair expenditures.
challenges.eligibilityCriteria: Hardware & software IP owned by startup, proven field test in urban water utility.

proposals.solutionTitle: EcoVision AI TrashCam & RouteOptima Gov Telematics Suite
proposals.proposedSolution: Integrated AI dual-camera vehicle telemetry hardware mounted on garbage compaction trucks coupled with RouteOptima Gov cloud engine for dynamic route enforcement, automated missed bin alerts, and fuel monitoring.
proposals.technicalApproach: Deploy 250 TrashCam Edge AI units with dual 1080p cameras running onboard MobileNet V3 models to verify bin emptying and check truck fill levels. Route tracking is updated every 3 seconds via 4G/GPS.
proposals.implementationPlan: Month 1: Hardware installation on 250 vehicles. Month 2: Route GIS mapping & driver onboard training. Months 3-5: Field testing & live telemetry. Month 6: Final evaluation & report.
proposals.teamDetails: Led by Ananya Sharma (Ex-ISRO Robotics Lead) and 8 senior IoT & Computer Vision engineers.
proposals.previousExperience: Deployed 120 units in Indore Smart City (achieved 94% route compliance) and 80 units in Surat Sanitation Fleet.
proposals.expectedOutcomes: 94% route completion, 97% GPS tracking uptime, missed collections reduced to 6%, fuel savings of 14.2%.
proposals.pilotPlan: Controlled pilot covering 4 municipal zones (Zones 3, 7, 11, 14) in Bhopal, serving 450,000 citizens.

proposals.solutionTitle: FleetPulse Civic IoT Route Compliance Engine
proposals.proposedSolution: Rugged GPS telematics loggers paired with driver tablet displays showing turn-by-turn route compliance indicators.
proposals.technicalApproach: Hardware OBD-II & GPS devices connected via cellular 4G to FleetPulse GIS cloud.
proposals.implementationPlan: Month 1: Fleet retrofit. Months 2-5: Live tracking. Month 6: Analytics report.
proposals.teamDetails: Team of 14 telematics engineers with 6 years experience in public transport management.
proposals.previousExperience: Tracked Pune public transport buses across 400 routes.
proposals.pilotPlan: Pilot across 2 municipal zones in Bhopal.

proposals.proposedSolution: RFID bin tags and RFID gate scanners at waste transfer stations to record truck arrival times and net payload weights.
proposals.technicalApproach: Ultra-high frequency RFID readers installed at 12 transfer stations in Bhopal.
proposals.expectedOutcomes: Accurate dump station logging, payload verification.
proposals.pilotPlan: Pilot across all 12 main waste transfer hubs.

proposals.solutionTitle: PulseBox Telehealth & AI Diagnostic Screening Kit
proposals.proposedSolution: Portable diagnostic briefcase containing 12-lead ECG, blood glucose, hemoglobinometer, digital stethoscope, and offline AI screening app.
proposals.technicalApproach: Android app performing local ML triage for ECG arrhythmia and diabetic retinopathy images. Auto-syncs to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) when internet reconnects.
proposals.implementationPlan: Month 1: Distribution of 30 PulseBox kits to Raichur PHCs. Months 2-5: Field screening. Month 6: Final clinical audit.
proposals.teamDetails: Co-founded by Dr. Rajesh Kumar (MBBS, AIIMS) and 12 medical hardware specialists.
proposals.previousExperience: Screened 35,000 patients in Mysore district rural PHCs.
proposals.expectedOutcomes: 93% diagnostic sensitivity, 99.4% offline sync reliability, 12 min screening duration.

proposals.solutionTitle: AquaHydro Acoustic Leak Detection Bug Network
proposals.proposedSolution: Sub-surface acoustic clamp-on sensors deployed on primary water feeder lines with AI transient pressure wave analysis.
proposals.technicalApproach: Deploy 150 acoustic bug sensors every 300 meters on Jaipur water pipeline grid.
proposals.implementationPlan: Months 1-2: Sensor clamping & calibration. Months 3-8: Continuous monitoring.
proposals.teamDetails: Hydrodynamics researchers and IoT hardware team from IIT Hyderabad.
proposals.previousExperience: Hydropolitan water supply NRW reduction pilot in Hyderabad.
proposals.expectedOutcomes: Detect leaks within 3 meters precision, save 4.8 million liters of water daily.

evaluations.comments: Exceptional proposal with proven computer vision hardware and strong track record in Indore. Dual camera fill verification adds distinct value over plain GPS loggers. Highly recommended for pilot approval.
CDSCO certified hardware with excellent ABDM compliance. Passed clinical verification with flying colors.
